name: Bug Report

description: Report an error or inaccuracy in the guide

title: "[Bug] "
labels: ["bug"]

body:

- type: markdown
  attributes:
    value: |
      ## Description

      [Describe the error or inaccuracy clearly]

      ## Expected behavior

      [What the guide should say or do]

      ## Actual behavior

      [What the guide currently says or does]

      ## Chapter / Section

      [Which chapter or section this applies to]

      ## Source

      [If this is a documentation accuracy issue, what source should be consulted?]

      ---

      ### Checklist

      - [ ] I have verified this is an error and not a style preference
      - [ ] I have checked the References section to confirm the correct source
      - [ ] I am reporting an error in the guide's content, not a feature request
